evals.name: practice-with-a-gap
evals.prompt: Make a Markdown source for notebook Q&A from tests/fixtures/notebook-sources/lighting.json. The other JSON files in that folder provide any available dependencies. The trusted Studio GAS checkout is ./studio-gas. Save the result in notebook-eval/practice.
evals.expected_output: One practice Markdown file preserves the unfamiliar authored field, repeats the referenced state checklist and identifies the unavailable supporting practice.
assertions: The output contains exactly one practice file.
The authored content includes futureField and its cobalt dial note.
The Colour Check / Verified reference includes the third-tile checklist criterion.
The export names Weather Calibration and marks the Studio view incomplete.

evals.name: method-with-members
evals.prompt: Can I get NotebookLM sources for Lantern Trial? Use tests/fixtures/notebook-sources/method.json and the other JSON files in that folder. The trusted Studio GAS checkout is ./studio-gas. Write the source files to notebook-eval/method.
evals.expected_output: One method file and two member practice files. The method file preserves the authored member order and the alpha binding.
assertions: The output contains exactly one method and two member files.
Colour Verification appears before Lantern Lighting in the method file.
The cross-baseline binding names both baselines and repeats the Colour Check definition.
